a2w.referenceDatumRule: Look up the project vertical_datum. NGVD29 or NAVD88 and the pool source is the same CWMS/A2W location's Top of Conservation/Multi-Purpose/Normal level -> same datum by construction (COMPATIBLE_SAME_SOURCE). Pool from a URL document -> need the document to state a datum; else UNKNOWN. LOCAL or blank -> UNKNOWN for absolute comparisons across sources (same-source CWMS pool still compatible). Never convert LOCAL.

Pool from non-CWMS URL -> require stated datum.

duke.referenceDatumRule: Duke publishes the series on a local scale where 100 = full pond, one unit per foot. Elevation = fullPondFt + (scale - 100). The full_pool.csv pools (Norman 760.0, Hickory 935.0, James 1200.0, Jocassee 1110.0, Keowee 800.0, Wateree 225.5, Wylie 569.4) are true NGVD29 elevations. shift = scale - 100 (ft), NOT scale - fullPoolFt. Lake Robinson (221.6) is reported in real feet, not on the 100-scale. A series value around 100 with a pool value in hundreds is the signature of the local scale; a plausibility guard is mandatory.

duke.notes: Verified from NWS metadata only for Norman, Hickory, James (NGVD29 gage zero 660/835/1100). Normal operating targets sit below full pond (Norman 98.5 summer, 96 winter) so the shift is negative most of the year by design.

usgs.referenceDatumRule: By parameter: 62614 -> NGVD29, 62615 -> NAVD88, 72020 -> NGVD29, 72275 -> USBR Klamath Basin datum (not convertible). 00062 -> UNKNOWN until a paired 62615/62614 series or a written site statement fixes the offset. 00065 -> gage height, never an elevation without the gage-datum altitude AND its datum. Pool datum: look at the pool source (CWMS pool -> location datum; operator document -> its stated datum); when pool and series datums differ and both are NGVD29/NAVD88 convert with NCAT.

datumChanges.what: USGS WMA 2020.02 mandated NAVD88 re-datum of active water-surface-elevation stations (deadline 2023-01-27). A site's 62614 series can therefore be discontinued and replaced by 62615; the bound parameter must be re-checked, and long histories can straddle a datum change.

usgs.notes: Bound counts (74): 62614 31, 62615 19, 00062 14, 00065 8, 72020 1, 72275 1 (Upper Klamath Lake, USBRKB datum). Santee Cooper lakes Marion (02171000) and Moultrie (02172000) are bound by 00062: Santee Cooper's lake-data page prints a rule curve (72.0 winter to 75.5 summer, FERC max 76.8) with no datum and points to the USGS gauges for live levels, so its figures are on the 00062 gauge scale; the USGS NAVD88 series (62615) reads 0.88 ft (Marion) / 0.99 ft (Moultrie) LOWER. NWS gauge PNVS1 (Marion) lists 'NAVD88 0' in its datum table while its observed value 72.96 equals USGS 00062, not 62615, so NWS metadata contradicts the numbers: do not trust NWS datum tables. Lake Murray: Dominion page shows 356.0 on 2026-10-13 (= USGS 00062 355.97), pool 360 is Saluda Plant Datum; NAVD88 = plant datum - 1.31 (62615 354.66).

nwps.referenceDatumRule: Do not rely on the SHEF code or the datum table. Accept NWPS levels only when (a) the observed magnitude is within a plausibility window of the pool (|obs - pool| < ~60 ft for flood-control/storage lakes) AND (b) the operator document for the pool states a datum or the gauge page does. Otherwise UNKNOWN. Georgia Power/Alabama Power/Duke/Dominion lakes appear via NWPS but their datum is that of the operator (see duke, usgs notes).
